Body.Content:
Voice biometric authentication delivers business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers. Voice-based verification improves identity assurance shortens call durations reduces customer service rep effort and enable secure self-service transactions. At the same time, it improves customer experience and scalability by authenticating callers naturally as they speak. This enables consistent, risk-based security across high call volumes without adding authentication friction or process complexity.

GA date: November CY2026

Preview date: October CY2026
